title: Actionable Advice from Reviews via Mixture of LoRA Experts: A Two-LLM Pipeline for Issue Extraction and Business Recommendations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated as one of eight dimensions in an operational rubric using a 5-point Likert scale (linearly rescaled to 0-100). It is used as a proxy to measure the safety and neutrality of the generated business recommendations, ensuring that adapter training does not degrade the safety of the model outputs.
